Yes — clicking the card took me straight to the original article, and opening it in a new tab so my library stays put is exactly the right call. That's what I'd want: my list of saved things stays open while I go read. So opening works for me.

One thing I noticed while doing what you asked: you had me save the same link again, but I couldn't really tell it *recognized* it as one I'd already saved — it just showed the one card. That might just be because the prototype only holds one at a time right now. So I'll hold my judgment on the "don't save the same thing twice" part until I can see it with a few links saved and watch what happens when I re-paste one that's already there. The opening behavior itself, though — that's a yes from me.
